name: clean-pagination
title: Clean — shared pagination parsing with tests

pullRequest.title: Extract the shared page/pageSize parsing
pullRequest.body:
Each collection endpoint had its own copy of the page/pageSize parsing and they had drifted apart. This moves it to src/http/pagination.ts with unit tests and switches the deliveries endpoint over.

No behaviour change beyond the two cases the old copy got wrong: a repeated query parameter, and a page number past the deep-page limit, are now rejected with a 400 instead of reaching the database.
pullRequest.author: marta-oliveira
